subtitlePage.emptyHint: Fetch from the platform, recognize locally or import a subtitle file.

styles.name: Style name
styles.previewHint: This is an HTML preview; “Render real frame” on the subtitle and export pages checks it with the actual burn-in.

export.noDrafts: No drafts yet; you can still export source subtitles or video.

export.softPreviewHint: Soft subtitles show the player's default track
export.clipPreviewHint: The preview is a fast low-res render; export renders again with the draft settings.
